result.instructions: Tools for Robaws, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which offers are still open for client Smith & Sons, and what is their total?"; "List the work orders planned for next Monday and who is assigned to each."; "Find the article with number 4521 and show its current price.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Robaws data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run robaws_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run robaws_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run robaws_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. robaws_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: robaws_whoami
tools.title: Show the connected Robaws user
tools.description: Show the Robaws user, tenant, permissions and companies that the connected API credentials belong to. Good first call to check the connection. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/whoami.

tools.name: robaws_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Search Robaws clients (customers and leads) by text, e-mail, VAT number or logic id. Returns one page of client records. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/clients.

searchText.description: Free-text search on the client name and fields.

logicId.description: Filter by the client's logic id.

page.description: Page index as the API counts it (the reply shows currentPage and totalPages).

size.description: Items per page (the API default applies when omitted).

sort.description: Sort expression passed to the API, for example 'name,asc'.

updatedFrom.description: Only records changed since this ISO date-time.

tools.name: robaws_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one Robaws client by id, with its address, billing settings and extra fields. Robaws API: GET /api/v2/clients/{id}.

client_id.description: The client id (from the matching search tool).

tools.name: robaws_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a Robaws client, or a lead when status is set to a status configured in Robaws. Creates a new record on every call (not idempotent). Robaws API: POST /api/v2/clients.

status.description: Client status, as configured in the Robaws client settings (for example a lead status).
